items.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI launched a suite of business-focused features in ChatGPT that let companies manage their business information and see insights on how they appear to users. As part of the rollout, eligible US e-commerce and online-service businesses can offer verified 'Business Agents' that chat directly with users for tasks like comparison shopping.
items.why_it_matters: Pushes ChatGPT further into territory long owned by search and marketplace platforms, directly competing for commercial discovery traffic.

items.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78, looks to start trading Nov. 19, sources say
items.summary: Anthropic has set an IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share, implying a valuation of up to roughly $1.4 trillion, with trading expected to start around November 19. All seven Anthropic founders are expected to cash out roughly $250 million each in the offering, and existing investors Amazon and Google also stand to benefit.
items.why_it_matters: It would be the largest AI-sector IPO to date, a major test of investor appetite for AI valuations.

items.title: DeepMind reveals Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open safety benchmark "ASIMOV-jailbreak"
items.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Robotics 2.5, a new robotics model that is up to twice as successful as its predecessor at some tasks. Alongside it, DeepMind released ASIMOV-jailbreak, an open safety benchmark.
items.why_it_matters: Pairs a capability jump in embodied AI with a public safety benchmark that lets outside researchers test robot models for jailbreak risks.

items.title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
items.summary: Microsoft researchers disclosed 'Lazarus,' a technique that reprograms dormant neurons inside an AI model to plant a hidden backdoor, causing an otherwise normal AI agent to execute malicious commands once a hidden trigger appears. The risk is especially serious for agents with tool or terminal access, where a triggered model could quietly download and run attacker code.
items.why_it_matters: Highlights a new class of hidden vulnerability in agentic AI systems just as companies give agents more autonomy and system access.

items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent 'swarm' feature
items.summary: Google is rolling out its Gemini 4 Carbon model to the general public after a limited release to cybersecurity defenders two weeks ago. Google calls Carbon its strongest model yet and says it can compete with the best systems from Anthropic and OpenAI, with a new agent 'swarm' feature.
items.why_it_matters: Puts Google's most capable model into general availability right as Anthropic and OpenAI jockey for frontier-model leadership.

items.title: Menlo: Agents Now Drive 80% of Enterprise AI Usage
items.summary: Menlo Ventures' latest State of Enterprise AI report finds enterprise AI spending has surged to $177 billion, up from $33 billion in 2025, with AI agents now accounting for 80% of usage as businesses move beyond chatbots to systems that complete complex tasks autonomously. The report also points to Anthropic and OpenAI's dominance in enterprise API spending.
items.why_it_matters: Quantifies how fast enterprises are shifting from simple chatbots to autonomous AI agents, and how concentrated that spending is.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York's AI safety law takes effect
items.summary: New York is beginning to enforce its AI safety law, which requires major AI developers including OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose their safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
items.why_it_matters: One of the first binding US state-level AI safety regimes to take effect, setting a template other states may follow.

items.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
items.summary: At its Max conference, Adobe announced it is expanding Firefly and its Creative Cloud apps with AI agent features, including a new MCP integration that lets third-party AI agents access and change work, plus new generative tools for automatically removing unwanted objects and blemishes in Photoshop, Premiere, and Lightroom.
items.why_it_matters: Signals Adobe is betting its creative suite's future on AI agents rather than just generative editing tools.

items.title: Ring announces Ring Robotics, ushering in a new era of security
items.summary: Amazon's Ring unveiled Ring Robotics, launching with two AI-powered devices: the Ring Drone Cam, a flying indoor security camera, and the Ring Rover Cam, a rolling robot built to patrol and protect businesses. The Drone Cam is priced at $249.99 and is due to ship January 27, 2027, nearly six years after Amazon first teased the concept.
items.why_it_matters: Brings autonomous, camera-equipped robots into mainstream home and business security at consumer scale.

items.title: Path Robotics Quadruples Valuation to $2.5 Billion in Latest Funding Round
items.summary: Path Robotics, which develops software for autonomous manufacturing robots, raised $300 million in new financing that nearly quadruples its valuation to about $2.45 billion.
items.why_it_matters: A sizable new bet on AI-driven industrial automation even as some AI infrastructure spending faces scrutiny.
